source_prompt: Ultra-detailed surreal pharmaceutical research laboratory at twilight, wide cinematic 16:9 composition. Center: a translucent teal glass molecular model of a double-helix drug scaffold floating above a brushed-steel bench, with glowing cyan bond lines and amber atom nodes. Left: a wall-sized holographic dashboard titled "EvidenceGrade AI" in bold white sans-serif, showing a 5-tier grade ladder (A emerald, B teal, C gold, D orange, F crimson) and a line chart labeled "Citation Confidence 2019-2026". Right: a large arched window revealing a rainy neo-Tokyo street with neon kanji signs reflecting on wet asphalt, a red umbrella leaning against the window sill, and a black cat silhouette on the ledge. Foreground: an open leather notebook with handwritten notes "CYP3A4 interaction risk" and a fountain pen, next to a white ceramic coffee cup with a teal lid and a cracked porcelain saucer. Ceiling: brass articulated lamps casting warm pools of light; one lamp has a green glass shade. Background shelves: amber glass reagent bottles labeled Aspirin, Warfarin, Ibuprofen in clean black type, a vintage brass microscope, and a small potted monstera plant with one yellow leaf. Atmosphere: volumetric god-rays through rain-streaked glass, subtle film grain, high dynamic range, teal-and-amber complementary color grade, no logos of real companies, no watermarks, photorealistic mixed with holographic UI.

results.reconstructed_prompt:
Cinematic photorealistic 3D render of a cozy, retro-futuristic pharmacology laboratory overlooking a rainy neon-lit Asian city street, wide 16:9 composition, eye-level view across a reflective brushed-metal worktable. Deep teal walls, atmospheric haze, warm brass fixtures, turquoise holographic accents, highly detailed glass, ceramic, paper, and metal textures. No people.

At left, a large transparent holographic dashboard angled in perspective, outlined with fine cyan light. Large bold white heading reads “EvidenceGrade AI”; beneath it, “5-tier grade”. Five vertically stacked outlined grade panels display “A”, “B”, “C”, “D”, “F”, respectively colored emerald green, cyan, mustard yellow, orange, and crimson. Beside them is a cyan line graph with thin gray grid lines, vertical scale labeled 0 through 60 in increments of 10, and a jagged upward-trending line. Text above and below the graph reads “Citation Confidence 2019-2026”.

Center frame, suspended above the table, a luminous molecular DNA double helix made of translucent turquoise glass spheres and connecting rods, punctuated by polished golden nodes, with an additional angular molecular branch near its lower right. Soft turquoise reflections fall onto the tabletop.

Foreground left, an open cream-colored spiral notebook on a brown leather folio, a dark green and gold fountain pen resting diagonally across the right page. Handwritten text on that page reads “CYP3A4”, “interaction”, “risk”; other small handwritten notes are unreadable. Foreground right, a white crackle-glazed ceramic cup with handle and dark teal takeaway-style lid on a matching white saucer.

Background shelves hold amber medicine bottles with white labels, including “Aspirin”, “Warfarin”, and “Ibuprofen”, test tubes, and upright pale binders. An antique brass microscope sits on the rear counter beside a potted monstera with green and yellow leaves. Overhead, articulated brass industrial task lamps, including one green enamel shade, cast warm pools of light.

At right, a large arched black-framed window reveals rain-streaked glass and a wet city street reflecting pink, cyan, and red neon storefront signs; the distant Chinese lettering is not reliably readable. A small black cat silhouette ornament sits on the windowsill, and a closed burgundy umbrella with a curved wooden handle leans below it. Quiet nighttime atmosphere, soft volumetric light, realistic reflections, restrained depth of field, cinematic teal-and-amber color grading.
